description: Rental Property Analyzer — Buy-and-hold rental property analysis, offline. Required: price=, rent= (monthly), rate= (mortgage %, not needed with down=100). Optional: down= % (default 25), term= years (30), closing_costs= % (3), rehab=, vacancy= % (5), management= % (8), maintenance= % (5), capex= % (5), property_tax= and insurance= annual $ (default 1.1% and 0.5% of price), hoa=, other= (monthly), other_income= (monthly), appreciation= % (3), rent_growth= %, expense_growth= % (2.5), hold= years (10), selling_costs= % (6). Returns monthly and annual NOI and cash flow, cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, GRM, 1% rule, break-even occupancy, hold-period IRR and equity multiple, verdict STRONG/OK/WEAK/NEGATIVE_CASH_FLOW, flags and assumptions. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
